searchText: Hi Guys, I hope someone can help me - noob question here. Can someone tell me how I can retreive informations stored in a transaction on eth? If I have a transaction on ethscanner, how is it possible to get those informations in a format that is more user-friendly? Pretty sure etherscan has a developer API
